threads.body: The workflow still checks out additional agent/config directories (.claude/.codex/.gemini/.pi), but the base-branch save/restore lists now only cover `.agents` and `.github`. This weakens the base-branch restoration guard because PR changes in those checked-out directories would persist and could influence agent behavior. Either (mandatory) add the checked-out config dirs/files back into `GH_AW_AGENT_FOLDERS`/`GH_AW_AGENT_FILES`, or remove those dirs from `sparse-checkout` so un-restored data isn’t present.

Same issue as PR Review: the workflow checks out `.claude/.codex/.gemini/.pi` but does not include them in the base-branch save/restore lists. If these directories affect behavior, a PR could modify them and bypass the intended ‘restore base’ protection. Align `GH_AW_AGENT_FOLDERS`/`GH_AW_AGENT_FILES` with the directories being checked out (or stop checking them out).
threads.hunk:
@@ -226,18 +227,16 @@ jobs:
           sparse-checkout: |
             .github
             .agents
-            .antigravity
             .claude
             .codex
             .gemini
-            .opencode
             .pi
           sparse-checkout-cone-mode: true
           fetch-depth: 1
       - name: Save agent config folders for base branch restoration
         env:
-          GH_AW_AGENT_FOLDERS: ".agents .antigravity .claude .codex .gemini .github .opencode .pi"
-          GH_AW_AGENT_FILES: "AGENTS.md ANTIGRAVITY.md CLAUDE.md GEMINI.md PI.md opencode.jsonc"
+          GH_AW_AGENT_FOLDERS: ".agents .github"
+          GH_AW_AGENT_FILES: "AGENTS.md"
